location: webhooks/partner.py -- verify_signature() never validates the parsed timestamp; only wrong given the bounded lifetime of the dedup table in WebhookHandler
mechanism: The timestamp is parsed and signed but never checked for freshness, so a captured request stays valid indefinitely. The only thing standing between a replay and a second dispatch is the _seen dedup table, and _prune deliberately bounds that table to SEEN_TTL_SECONDS. Anyone who captures one delivery can therefore replay it unchanged after the TTL and have the event dispatched again, repeatedly and forever -- exactly the outcome the constant's own comment says the design must avoid.
